thread:
Lena: Heads up — VectorWorks (customer_id: vector-007) disputed INV-20260515. They were charged $4,560 in burst/overage and say their traffic never spiked. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/INV-20260515.pdf. Can billing take a look?

Samir: On it. Grabbing the usage export now: s3://billing-exports/vector-007/2026-05.csv. Quick query I'm running to look for anomalies:
```sql
SELECT timestamp, request_id, node_type, tokens, event_id
FROM dedicated_usage
WHERE customer_id='vector-007' AND date='2026-05-15'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```

ops-bot: Export ready — vector-007/2026-05.csv (s3://billing-exports/vector-007/2026-05.csv). BILL-3310 created to track this invoice investigation.

Samir: Found a tight cluster around 2026-05-15T02:12:00Z where many rows share the same request_id but different event_id (pod restart + retry). Appears meter service emitted duplicate events for the same logical request during a small window. That double-counts tokens.

Elena: VectorWorks support confirms they saw repeated client retries at 02:12 UTC due to a transient 502. They provided app logs showing retries but not repeated user actions. Support ticket #4602.

Samir: Action plan: 1) Generate a corrected usage file deduping by request_id within a 60s window and mark duplicates nonbillable. 2) Open INF ticket for the meter-emitter retries (INF-7901). 3) Propose credit for the net overage from duplicates and a small goodwill credit. I'll produce numbers in an hour.

Samir: Update: corrected export posted s3://billing-exports/vector-007/corrections/2026-05-deduped.csv. Duplicate tokens removed total = 1.14M tokens -> overage delta = $4,560.

Lena: Recommend applying full overage credit $4,560 plus $250 goodwill for the disruption. Approve provisional credit of $4,810 to INV-20260515 while INF-7901 runs. Please notify the customer and link support #4602.

Samir: Approved. Applying provisional credit now and annotating invoice: "Provisional credit for meter duplication — under review". ops-bot: BILL-3310 updated (provisional credit $4,810 applied).

ops-bot: INF-7901 created: meter-emitter dedup investigation. PM task PM-1030 filed to add request_id deduping to billing pipeline and add reconciliation alert.

Elena: Messaged VectorWorks: "We've applied a provisional credit of $4,810 and are correcting our usage records. We expect final confirmation within 48 hours." They replied: "Thanks, we'll proceed with payment once confirmed."

Samir: Patch deployed to meter-emitter to suppress duplicate events; reconciled invoice updated and final credit $4,810 applied to INV-20260515. s3 link for artifacts: s3://billing-exports/vector-007/artifacts/INV-20260515-dedup-report.txt

Lena: Confirmed final credit applied. Closing BILL-3310 and support #4602. Please ensure PM-1030 tracks verification and alerting so this doesn't recur.

Samir: Done — closing out from billing side.

Elena: Customer acknowledged receipt of credit and moved forward with procurement. :white_check_mark:
